langSectionDesc: Switch display language. Changes will immediately apply across all dashboards, metrics, and reports.
aiModelDesc: Configure Large Language Models for workout debriefs, weekly progress analysis, and race strategy predictions. Supports standard providers and local endpoints.
apiKeyPlaceholderSaved: Secured (leave empty to keep current key)
apiKeyPlaceholderOllama: Local Ollama requires no auth (leave empty or 'ollama')
tokensHint: Default: 64,000. Reasoning models (DeepSeek-R1, OpenAI o1/o3-mini) share tokens between reasoning and completion. Caps are applied automatically per provider limit.
athleteProfileDesc: Manage your biometrics (birthday, height, weight) and HR zones. Zones define Z1-Z5 distribution in workouts and weekly summaries; height and weight calculate running economy and mechanical climb work.
birthdayHint: Used for max HR estimation, fatigue recovery curves, and age group benchmarking
birthdayAgeTanaka: Age {age} · Tanaka theoretical max HR ~{hr} bpm
genderHint: Used for heart rate reserve calculations and peer benchmarking
heightHint: Evaluates Stride-to-Height Ratio for biomechanical injury prevention
weightHint: Accurately calculates active calories and uphill mechanical work
bmiNotice: Weight affects energy expenditure calculations without penalizing flat pace predictions
maxHrHint: Leave empty to estimate from lap history (median of high-intensity lap peaks), fallback to Tanaka
restingHrHint: Heart rate upon waking. Leave empty to use physiological median of 55.
copyEffectiveToCustom: 📋 Copy current estimates to custom zones
hrFormDesc: Enter lower and upper heart rate bounds (bpm). Below Z1 is categorized as 'Z0 Active Recovery'. Z5 has no upper bound (match watch and leave empty):
z5Hint: bpm (watch '> {val}' has no upper limit, leave empty)
sportsFilterDesc: Select workout categories to import across COROS and Garmin ecosystems. Unselected categories are ignored during sync.
minOneSportWarn: Select at least one sport, otherwise no data will be synced.
connectWatchFirst: Please connect COROS or Garmin watch account above first
saveSportsHint: Changes only affect future syncs; existing database records are preserved.
syncDaysDesc: Configure lookback timeframe for historical workouts. Data is kept 100% local on your machine.
syncDaysTip: Recommended 365 days: Historical records extract continuous benchmark efforts for accurate race predictions. Existing activities are de-duplicated automatically.
watchAccountsDesc: Manage sports watch connections. Supports concurrent COROS and Garmin (China & Global) sync with credentials kept on your local device.
workflowsDesc: After data sync completes, the background pipeline executes these analysis steps:
